patches_added.name: Redirect LINE Pay
patches_added.description: Forwards LINE Pay flows to the standalone LINE Pay app instead of running them in-app, so the device-integrity check that fails on a re-signed build never runs. Messaging is unaffected.

patches_removed.name: Disable LINE Pay
patches_removed.description: Closes any LINE Pay screen immediately on open, so Pay flows (and their device-integrity check) never run. Messaging is unaffected.

patches_modified.name: Disable LINE Premium
patches_modified.description: Hides all LINE Yahoo Premium (LYP) surfaces — upsells, badges, the Premium settings page, and subscribe/manage flows. Doesn't unlock anything (premium is server-enforced).

patches_modified.name: Disable VOOM
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes VOOM entry points — deep links, shares, and notifications do nothing and the standalone VOOM feed closes on open. Messaging and other tabs are unaffected.

patches_modified.name: Hide premium unsend upsells
patches_modified.description: Removes the LYP premium-unsend upsells that survive "Disable LINE Premium": the "Unsend discreetly" button, the post-unsend promo link, and the expired-window unsend upsell. Ordinary unsend still works.
